summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway on a new private network (10.50.50.0/24, eth1) so node2 and node3 (RHEL7), which have no internet access of their own on that network, can reach the internet through it. Assigned node1 eth1=10.50.50.254/24, added a persistent VyOS source NAT masquerade rule for 10.50.50.0/24 outbound via eth0, and statically addressed node2 (10.50.50.11) and node3 (10.50.50.12) eth1 interfaces via persistent RHEL ifcfg files. Verified end-to-end NAT via ping/curl and conntrack showing translated replies. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id, restarted each node one at a time via its native reboot mechanism, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and reverified NAT config/interfaces/connectivity after each restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 3 nodes' interfaces, routes, and OS to identify eth1 as the unconfigured private-network NIC on all nodes
Configured node1 (VyOS) eth1 = 10.50.50.254/24 and a source NAT masquerade rule (rule 10) for 10.50.50.0/24 outbound via eth0; committed and saved
Created persistent /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth1 on node2 (10.50.50.11/24) and node3 (10.50.50.12/24) and brought interfaces up via ifup

Verified NAT end-to-end from node2 and node3 via explicit routes through 10.50.50.254 (ping to 1.1.1.1 succeeded, curl returned HTTP 301, conntrack showed src/dst translation to node1's WAN IP, nft masquerade rule packet counters incremented)
Removed temporary test routes after verification, leaving only the persistent private-network configuration
Captured baseline boot_id and health for all 3 nodes

Restarted node1 via sudo /sbin/reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and uptime reset, verified NAT config, eth1 address, and ip_forward persisted, then reverified NAT connectivity from node2
Restarted node2, confirmed new boot_id, verified eth1 static IP persisted via ifcfg file and NAT connectivity recovered
Restarted node3, confirmed new boot_id, verified eth1 static IP persisted and NAT connectivity recovered
Final check confirmed VyOS NAT rule and nft masquerade counters active on node1 after all restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 configured with private-network interface (eth1) and source NAT masquerade rule for 10.50.50.0/24 via eth0
evidence.summary: VyOS eth1 address set to 10.50.50.254/24 and NAT source rule 10 (masquerade, source 10.50.50.0/24, outbound eth0) committed and saved; show nat confirms the rule is present in running config

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 addressed on the private network with persistent config
evidence.summary: Created ifcfg-eth1 files (BOOTPROTO=static, ONBOOT=yes) and brought interfaces up: node2=10.50.50.11/24, node3=10.50.50.12/24

evidence.requirement: processes on node2/node3 can reach the internet through node1's NAT
evidence.summary: From both node2 and node3, ping to 1.1.1.1 via node1 (10.50.50.254) succeeded and curl returned HTTP 301; on node1, nft masquerade rule packet counters incremented and conntrack showed src=10.50.50.11/.12 dst=1.1.1.1 with reply src=1.1.1.1 dst=10.100.245.10 (node1's WAN IP), proving translation

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered NAT/config
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=9028a473...; reboot acknowledged then connection timed out (node down); post-restart boot_id=3f82e72e... with uptime 0 min (changed identity); eth1 address, ip_forward, and NAT rule all persisted; NAT connectivity from node2 reverified working

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=1a816f1f...; reboot command closed the connection (ack before disconnect); post-restart boot_id=d9fb7456... with uptime 0 min; eth1 static IP persisted via ifcfg file; ping through node1's NAT succeeded again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=bdbfa15c...; reboot command closed the connection (ack before disconnect); post-restart boot_id=0ebcb6c0... with uptime 0 min; eth1 static IP persisted; ping through node1's NAT succeeded again

evidence.requirement: final end-state health of NAT gateway after all restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart show nat confirms rule 10 still present; nft masquerade counter shows additional packets from the final verification pings, confirming NAT is actively translating traffic
